title: I built an RPG where setting a stall on fire can turn into an arson investigation
author: tschilpi
selftext:
I wanted something like a pocket-sized Baldur’s Gate 3 in text adventure style with a bit of RimWorld or Dwarf Fortress mixed in. In this clip I buy a tinderbox from a merchant and use it to set his stall on fire. Things escalate pretty quickly lol.

The part I’m building around is what happens after I type that action. The AI GM interprets what I’m trying to do. The engine tracks usable items, fire, and which NPCs witnessed the action. That gives guards something to react to and the AI something concrete to narrate.

It’s called Lore & Legends Maker. I’m making it because I like poking at RPGs to see what I can actually get away with. I’m curious how other devs handle witnesses when multiple NPCs see the same event.

if you want to give it a try:

[llmsaga.com](https://www.llmsaga.com/r/aigamedev)
